book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Pailod Jisas manö kub haga
Anɨg hageila, Pailod ami bɨ nɨpe gau hagö, Jisas nɨp nagɨ udöm pak ado malo gɨla.
Anɨg göl paköm, nan kalɨ kalɨ halö rɨmnap udöm, kiŋ lɨbal rö usajɨl bad ap göm, Jisas nɨp rol gɨ ñöm, waƚɨj mu mɨlö bö ap lɨ ñöm,
nɨp kuöyaŋ amöm kuöyaŋ amöm hagla, “Ne Juda kai kiŋ kale, ne pör nöp mɨdaimön!” a gɨla. Anɨg hagöl gɨ, nɨp mulu maj mɨgan pakla.
Pen Pailod kuöyaŋ höŋ amöm, Juda nɨbi bɨ kalɨp haga, “Nɨŋim! Yad Jisas nɨp höŋ i daunabin nɨŋöm kale nɨŋnabim, yad nɨpe nan naij göp iƚ ap uƚhai nɨŋagpin,” a ga.
Pen Jisas nɨp usajɨl kalɨ kalɨ halö bad u rol gɨ ñöm, waƚɨj mu mɨlö bö adö lɨ ñɨla u halö auö nɨŋöl gɨ, Pailod kalɨp haga, “Nɨp nɨŋim!” a ga.

Anɨg hageia, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau abe, God sabe gep ram polisman gau abe, Jisas nɨp nɨŋöm manö bƚaƚö göm hagla, “Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmim! Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmim!” a gɨla. Anɨg hageila, Pailod haga, “Kale ke nɨp dammim, mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmim. Yad nan naij göp iƚ ap uƚhai nɨŋagpin!” a ga.
Hageia, Juda kai hagla, “Nɨpe, ‘Yad God Ñɨ nɨpe,’ a ga u, lo hon ap hagöp, ‘Umnɨm,’ a göp,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, Pailod nɨŋöm, rapɨn pɨñɨŋ göm,
kuöyaŋ ram raul yaŋ amöm, Jisas nɨp hag nɨŋöm haga, “Ne ram mɨnöŋ gai nɨbö?” ö ga. Hageia, Jisas manö ap pen hagaga.
Pailod haga, “Ne yɨp manö hagagnabön ar? Ne nɨŋban. Yad nöp abad mɨdpin. Anɨb u, nöp hubɨk yunɨg hubɨk yunabin; pen nöp mab ba laŋ al pak löl, a gɨnö, al pak lɨnaböl,” a ga.
Hageia, Jisas haga, “Pen ne yɨp abad mɨdpan u, ne ke wasö, God nöp hagö abad mɨdpan. Anɨb u, yɨp gɨ naij gabön marö u, ne nöp udagnabön; bɨ yɨp udöm nöp ñöb u, marö kub yabɨƚ u udnab,” a ga.

Jisas anɨg hageia, Pailod nɨp yɨharɨŋ hag yuɨn, a göm, gasɨ nɨŋa u pen Juda kai nɨp bƚaƚö gɨ hagöm hagla, “Ne Jisas nɨp hubɨk yunabön u, Rom bɨ kub Sisa bɨ nɨŋeb nɨpe mɨdageinabön. Bɨ, yad kiŋ mɨdpin, a gɨpal gau, Sisa aip pen pen al lun, a göm me, manö anɨbu rö hagpal,” a gɨla.

Anɨg hageila, Pailod manö anɨbu nɨŋöm, am Jisas nɨp uɫ gɨ höŋ amöm, nɨpe am bɨ manö ud asɨkep sea adö au laŋ gɨla adö u asɨka. Ka asɨka anɨbu, “Kabö Adan” a gɨmɨdal. Pen Arameik manö löm, “Gabada” a gɨmɨdal.
Pen ñɨn anɨbu, Juda nɨbi bɨ Pasopa nan kale magum gep ñɨn. Sɨdö aŋ kub laŋ magö u, Pailod kalɨp haga, “Kiŋ kale me i!” a ga.

Hageia, meg magö dap ranöm hagla, “Nɨp al pak lɨ! Nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨ!” a gɨla. Hageila, Pailod haga, “Kiŋ kale anɨbi mab ba laŋ al pak lɨnam?” ö ga. Hageia, bɨ God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau hagla, “Kiŋ hon ap mɨdagöp; Rom bɨ kub Sisa nöp mɨdöp,” a gɨla.
Pen anɨg gɨ hag damöm, Pailod manö kalɨp u udöm, ami bɨ gau kalɨp haga, “Jisas nɨp dam mab ba laŋ al pak lɨmim,” a ga.
Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak lɨla
Pen nɨp al pak lɨnɨg gɨla mab u, Jisas nɨp ñɨlö, nɨpe dam “Wip Nabɨc Cög Ij” a gɨpal dum u apjaka. Dum anɨbu, Arameik manö löm “Golgoda” a gɨmɨdal.
Jisas nɨp mab kros cɨpɨƚ pak löm, bɨ mɨhöp, ap böŋ lap, ap böŋ lap, al pak lɨla. Jisas aŋ au mɨdeia.
Pen Pailod hagö, bɨ nɨpe gau mab po ap udöm kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, Jisas nɨp al pak lɨla mab ba nabɨc au gɨdaŋ dɨƚam gɨla. Kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla manö u: JISAS NASARED NƗBÖ JUDA KAI KIŊ KALE ME I.
Manö añɨ adö anɨbu nöp, Arameik manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, Ladin manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, Grik manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm gɨla me, Jerusalem söl anɨb au mɨdeia rö, Juda nɨbi bɨ iru nöp amgö lɨ nɨŋla.

Pen God nɨp nan sabe gep bɨ kub gau am Pailod nɨp hagla, “Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkpan u kabö rö gagöp. ‘Juda kai kiŋ kale’ manö u mɨdagainɨm; yɨharɨŋ hagmön, ‘Nɨpe hagöp, “Yad Juda kai kiŋ kale mɨdpin,” a göp,’ a gɨmön, manö anɨbu nöp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkmön,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila pen Pailod pen haga, “Yad manö nɨhön kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkpin u, anɨg göl nöp mɨdnab,” a ga.
Pen Jisas nɨp mab ba laŋ al pak löm, ami bɨ mɨhau mɨhau Jisas waƚɨj nɨpe gau balu ke ke udöm, waƚɨj mɨlö bö göm al dör gagla u, u rö nöp balu udnɨg hagla,

“Pabu gagun! Yɨharɨŋ sadu rö gun, bɨ an udnɨm u, nɨpe udnab,” a gɨla. Gɨla anɨbu, God hadame nöp nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp gasɨ ñö, God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, hainö anɨg gɨnaböl, a gɨla u me, hainö anɨg unbö rö nöp gɨla. Manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla,

content.text: “Waƚɨj yad u balu ke ke udöm,
waƚɨj mɨlö bö yad u, sadu rö gun udun, a gɨla,” a gɨla.

content: Pen ñɨn anɨbu, Jisas nɨme u, nɨmañ u, Klopas nɨbin Maria u, Maria Magdala u, ap Jisas nɨp al pak lɨla goƚ söl anɨb au mɨdeila.
Yad Jon, Jisas yɨp mɨdmagö lɨmɨdöp bɨ u, u rö nöp ap söl anɨb au mɨdainö u me, Jisas yɨp nɨŋöm, nɨme Maria nɨp haga, “Nɨbi me, ñɨ ne me u,” a ga.
Anɨg hagöm, nɨpe pen nɨme Maria nɨŋöm yɨp haga, “Name ne me u,” a ga. Anɨg hagö nɨŋöl gɨ, ñɨn anɨbu, Jisas nɨme nɨp uɫ gɨ ram yad u damem, aip mɨdmɨdul.
Jisas uma
Jisas nɨŋa, wög adö nɨpe u magöŋhalö gɨ haka u me, God Manö haga u nɨŋö lɨnɨm a göm haga, “Yɨp rugu mɨƚep göp,” a ga.
Pen ñɨg wain asɨ barol ap dap anɨb au lɨlö mɨdeia u me, ami bɨ ap, nan hain bad ap udöm, wain asɨ anɨbu löm, ud mab hisop lö adɨŋ u abös alöm, dap ranöm Jisas maj hañ adö nɨp u la.
Jisas ñɨg wain asɨ anɨbu ñɨŋöm haga, “Naböŋ juöp,” a göm, ubör yɨhöŋ göm, ana nɨpe ña.
Jisas rɨglöm nɨpe u bɨnɨŋ gɨla

Pen Juda bɨ kub gau, kagoƚ ñɨn u dugo magö u hadö auajɨp nɨŋöm hagla, “Rol God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn hon u, wip gau mab ba laŋ mɨdagaiöl,” a göm, am Pailod nɨp hagla, “Bɨ mab ba laŋ al pak lɨbal gau, ami bɨ gau ma kalɨp gau pa jö gɨlö, yɨŋɨd umlö, ud mɨnöŋ yaŋ löl,” a gɨla.
Hageila, Pailod ami bɨ gau kalɨp hagö, am bɨ Jisas aip al pak lɨla mɨhau, ma kalɨp gau pa jö gɨla.
Pen Jisas ma nɨp u pa jö gun a göm nɨŋla, nɨpe hadö uma. Anɨg ga u me, ma nɨpe u pa jö gagla.
Pen ami bɨ ap, waƚab ap udöm, Jisas nɨp rɨglöm adɨŋ au bɨnɨŋ gö, adɨŋ hagape halö, ñɨg halö luga.
Anɨb u, kale nɨbi bɨ manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkabin anɨbi nɨŋnabim gau abe Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udmim, a gem, yad Jon, Jisas nɨp ga u amgö yad ke nɨŋbin rö, kalöp manö nɨŋö yabɨƚ anɨbi hagem kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkabin.

Pen ga anɨbu, God hadame nöp nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp gasɨ ñö, God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm, hainö anɨg gɨnaböl, a gɨla u me, hainö anɨg unbö rö nöp gɨla. God Manö u kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla, “Le nɨpe u, ap pa jö gagnaböl,” a gɨla.
Pen manö ap hagla, “Bɨ nɨp bɨnɨŋ gajal u nɨp nɨŋnaböl,” a gɨla.
Josep nɨpe Jisas hañ romaŋ dam rɨgöl ga

Bɨ Arimadia daun nɨbö ap, Jisas manö nɨpe nɨŋ uda u pen, Juda bɨ kub kalɨp pɨñɨŋ göm, Jisas nɨp nɨŋ udpin, a göm, waiö hagagmɨdöp. Bɨ anɨbu hib nɨpe Josep. Nɨpe Jisas nɨp dam rɨgöl gɨnam, a göm, am Pailod nɨp hag nɨŋö, yau a gö, ud ara.

Nikodimas nɨpe Josep aip arlö. Nikodimas, bɨ au nöd am Jisas nɨp sɨbön yaŋ nɨŋa bɨ u. Nikodimas nan haƚɨŋ aij auep iru nöp, kilo unbö ñɨnjuöl ado gɨ da unbö ajɨp böŋ daŋ (35) rö, udöm ara. Nan haƚɨŋ aij auep anɨbu, mab mö cɨl u abe, mab alos cɨl u abe udöm gɨla.
Pen kale mɨhöp am wip he u ud asɨk dap lugmil, Juda nɨbi bɨ gɨmɨdal rö, mab cɨl ud ara u, wip he gau anöŋ lɨ ñɨmil, linɨn ud waƚɨj rud gɨla pro mɨlö u udmil, wam wam gɨlö.
Jisas mab ba laŋ al pak lɨla ka anɨb söl au wög adɨŋ ap mɨdeia. Wög adɨŋ anɨbu aŋ au kabö mɨgan gɨsön nöp ƚuöm, wip rɨgöl gagla ap mɨdeia.
Juda kai God nɨp sabe gep ñɨn kale u söl söl ga rö, yɨŋɨd rɨgöl gul a gɨmil, kabö mɨgan yöp söl anɨb au rɨgöl gɨlö.
